admission.justification: A future lane change must not certify absence or coverage merely because relevant knowledge could not be read.

applicability: The four-tree reviewer parse-unknown boundary chosen in MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6.
conditions: A non-text change whose relevant knowledge cannot establish attribution retains the native unknown bucket/reason rather than confirmed absence; unrelated parse problems are not blanket evidence against another path.
exclusions: Not every parse problem makes every path unknown; the gate and reviewer can differ under their explicit exact-recorded-range versus mapped-range rules.
statement: A parse problem can prevent attribution of a non-text change and Unknown then remains the truthful classification.
